item.title: Michael Saylor Says BIP-110 Miner Signaling Falls Far Short of Threshold
item.summary: Michael Saylor reported on August 4 that BIP-110 miner signaling on Bitcoin stood at just 2.70% at block 961,022, far below the 55% voluntary threshold, and argued the proposal would stall or fork into irrelevance as mandatory enforcement approaches at block 961,632.
